label: Actual-root favourings are good-general, from nonlimitation and the formal object
meaning: Fix an actual root r at w and a favouring determination favours phi of r. Actual roots have no represented limiting principle (its distinct simply prior being is the shared CausalityFrame's PriorSimply, PRIOR_1), so by the RootPurity bridge every real determination of r is pure, favours phi among them. By the per-bearer bridge, phi favours x over y exactly where its formal object for r ranks x over y, and by the object premise that object is the value order v's relation (STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1). Betterness varies within an end-realization class: some x is better than y at s, at least one of them not a present input, and not at a scenario t that agrees with s on end-realization. Then phi favours x over y at s and not at t, so phi depends on betterness with end-realization fixed (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2) and is good-general. The main theorem uses no axioms. Neither the per-bearer bridge nor the object premise mentions whether the favouring is a natural or a rational appetite. It is a conditional alternative formulation inside the purity family that splits lane P's value-sense bridges (b86a2364) into a part the D-directed rival accepts (the per-bearer bridge) and the part it denies (the object premise); it adds no independent warrant to e2357adc's rationale. It does not use the #2153 admissible family, joint compossibility, the purity of good-generality e2357adc, one-favouring realization 3e6ae3e7, the E premise or the cognition criterion. Its conclusion 7fca65ec is already closed by other routes; this result adds a conditional support bundle with three open premises (2306492a, f2e8eb42, ca3c311d) and changes no closure. Comparator companions (Mathlib axioms): formalObjectControls gives, on the #2153 two-being carrier with the Lane 2b profiles, a positive witness and for each non-logical premise a row where it fails, the others hold and the conclusion fails; in the positive row the favouring is fixed by the content state (as every profile there is) and not by the empty apprehension state, and the cognition criterion fails with Lane 4's appNone relation (the two are linked only by interpretation); its fifth row is the D-directed nature measured by its own end, where only the object premise fails. appetiteGrid gives the good-tracking profile fixed by a content state and by a full apprehension state, both good-general; the D-directed profile fixed by a state determined to one end-content class; the profile facts used by the per-bearer reading; common-value verdicts; the cognition criterion holding with appSource and failing with appNone on the good-tracking source; and a two-bearer model of one profile (dNature = determinedWill) with bearer-indexed formal objects, where the kind rule holds without fixing the natural bearer's object, the natural bearer's favouring makes exactly its object's verdicts, and the willing bearer's identical favouring does not. GoodGeneral and the route's premises do not encode mode; the encodings do not require a natural state to be non-apprehensive. The assignments say nothing about what favouring, purity, value, nature or apprehension are.
